# confirm / prompt — edge-hub: confirm / prompt of what an Edge admin page imports (shared/layer.js, shared/notice.js, shingoedge.js's api)
# a fresh page per case; #opener has focus when the dialog opens. "after 60 s" is the
# fake clock moved a minute on: a dialog still pending then never resolves by itself.

## confirm
confirm(msg): the DOM it writes: focus button.btn
    div class="layer-scrim"
      div class="layer-card" role="alertdialog" aria-modal="true"
        p class="layer-msg"
          "Delete <b>BIN-1</b> & \"its\" tags?"
        div class="layer-foot"
          button class="btn" type="button" listens=click
            "Cancel"
          button class="btn btn-danger" type="button" data-layer-ok="" listens=click
            "Confirm"
confirm: OK: resolves true, no overlay left, focus #opener
confirm: Cancel: resolves false, no overlay left, focus #opener
confirm: Escape on body, after 60 s: resolves false, no overlay left
confirm: Escape on its OK button, after 60 s: resolves false, no overlay left
confirm: the page opened and hid a modal with this surface's showModal first, then Escape on body, after 60 s: resolves false, no overlay left
confirm: press and click the overlay (backdrop), after 60 s: pending, 1 overlay(s) left: "layer-scrim"
confirm: a second one opened while the first is open: 2 overlays; OK on the second: first pending, second resolves true; then Cancel on the first: first resolves false, no overlay left
confirm: OK clicked twice: resolves true, no overlay left
confirm(non-string message 42): the message node:
    p class="layer-msg"
      "42"

## prompt
prompt(msg): the DOM it writes, focus after a tick: focus at open input.layer-input, after a tick input.layer-input
    div class="layer-scrim"
      div class="layer-card" role="alertdialog" aria-modal="true"
        p class="layer-msg"
          "Delete <b>BIN-1</b> & \"its\" tags?"
        input class="layer-input" type="text" value="" listens=keydown
        div class="layer-foot"
          button class="btn" type="button" listens=click
            "Cancel"
          button class="btn btn-primary" type="button" data-layer-ok="" listens=click
            "OK"
prompt(msg, {type:"number", min:1, max:9, value:5}): the input: type "number", min "1", max "9", value "5"
prompt(msg, {type:"date"}): the input type: "text"
prompt: OK untouched, no default: resolves "", no overlay left, focus #opener
prompt: OK untouched, {value:"5"}: resolves "5"
prompt: OK untouched, {value:0}: resolves "0"
prompt: {value:"5"}, cleared to empty, OK: resolves ""
prompt: typed "abc", OK: resolves "abc"
prompt: typed "abc", Enter in the input: resolves "abc", no overlay left
prompt: typed "abc", Escape in the input: resolves null, no overlay left
prompt: typed "abc", Cancel: resolves null, no overlay left
prompt: Escape on body, after 60 s: resolves null, no overlay left
prompt: press and click the overlay (backdrop), after 60 s: pending, 1 overlay(s) left: "layer-scrim"
prompt: over an open modal (this surface's showModal), Escape in the input: resolves null, the modal underneath open
prompt: a second one opened while the first is open: 2 overlays, focus input.layer-input in overlay 2; Enter in the first: first resolves "one", second pending, 1 overlay(s) left: "layer-scrim"
